title: Toms3Core
description: Core with utilities and patches for anarchy servers
body:
### Open-source core designed for toms3.cc and other anarchy servers. 
### Currently in development.

**NO FOLIA SUPPORT YET!**

**Bugs** -> Report them to the GitHub repository

**Suggestions** -> Same as above

Contributions are welcome, code is kinda messy but works well (at least with ~20 players).

Best paired with [AnarchyExploitFixes](https://github.com/xGinko/AnarchyExploitFixes).

If you are also looking for a /kill & /suicide integration, [check this out](https://modrinth.com/plugin/bettersuicide).

# Features
- Player utility commands like joindate, playtime, lastseen and vote
- Joke commands (/dupe & /seed)
- Joke commands with Discord webhook connection integration (/dupe)
- Utility admin commands
- MOTD when entering the server
- MOTD when entering the server for the first time
- Announcer system (title and chat messages)
- Anti-illegals system
- Tile entity per chunk limit system with logging system
- English and spanish support (mostly hardcoded)
- Prevents players from entering the Nether Roof without killing them
- Fixes the "vclip exploit", used to enter and travel under the bedrock in the Nether
# Main Commands
- /tmcore
- /tmcore reload
- /tmcore help
- /tmcore get_player_by_uuid
- /tmcore get_uuid_by_player
# Utilities
- /joindate (/jd)
- /playtime (/pt)
- /lastseen (/ls)
- /vote
# Joke Commands
- /dupe
- /seed
